data: A MEASUREMENT DOCUMENT of the route sweep (the project's order 15 October 2026 09:0x UK, the per-hash switching network), route 100 percent on the k2-lean form of record on the chain form (DOC-v21-forge2-anvilr-pair-k2-lean-p64-m16-l8-s128: Anvil-R fp_mode 6, M 16, 128 steps in 8 entries, the per-pair sequence, prefetch 16, the keyed read every second step, the lean mix, period_blocks 64 at chain 7358). route: the share of each step's operands whose SOURCE LANE is drawn per hash from the state through the cross-lane class: the slots k with k mod 4 < 4 read their first operand from lane (l + 1 + nibble) mod 16, the nibble the lane's four bits of fchain(x, k) (lanes 0 to 7) or fchain(x, 32 + k) (lanes 8 to 15), x the step's route word = fchain(fold over the 16 lanes of (x ^ r0) + r1, t) taken from the PREVIOUS step's result (the init's word for step 0), so the lane graph of a step is known only when the previous step ends and cannot be prepared ahead; the operand's value, the destination and the rest of the slot unchanged. the GPU team measures it as mined on both cards with the step's instruction count; the security review prices the per-hash switching network against the share.
counters: ROUTED CROSS-LANE OPERAND READS A HASH: 32 slots a step x 16 lanes x 128 steps = 65536 (the trace line 'forge2 route' prints them), beside the XLANE class's own reads (3 of 32 slots under QUOTA_INT, about 6,144 a hash) and the keyed reads (64 items, 16 KiB); the route word 128 fold-and-draw chains of 17 operations a hash and 8192 fchain draws for the nibbles.
fits_die_sram_7nm: no (the gigabyte 8.6 Gbit); a chip's SRAM an attempt 3 KiB
red_team_chip_row: pending: the security review's price of the per-hash switching network at this share (a 16-lane crossbar whose setting is drawn per step from the previous step's result)
floating: integer-only as mode 6's; the floating counters read 0 on every set
fixed_cost: as the k2-lean form's (about 792 bytes of BLAKE3 a hash) plus the route chain above
